prompt: In chess, a queen moves any number of squares along its row, column or diagonals, without jumping over pieces. A queen sits alone on square d4 of an otherwise empty board. How many squares can it move to?
explanation: Along its row and column the queen reaches 7 + 7 = 14 squares. On the diagonals from d4 it reaches 4 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 13 squares. In total, 14 + 13 = 27 squares.
